result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as an alias of `updateLandscape`. It compiles (`mvn -q -o -pl cli compile`), but I didn't run it or any tests.

- **`Commands.java`:** I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION`. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` just before `updateLandscape`, with the same options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** both names go to the same `updateLandscape(args)` handler, so options and behaviour are identical. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name was typed: `analyzeLandscape` shows its own name and description, and `updateLandscape` still shows its own.
- **`README.md`:** it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It lists `analyzeLandscape` as the landscape command and `updateLandscape` as the same thing kept for compatibility. It also covers `init`, `generateReports` and `updateConfig`.
